subtitle: Pets, appointments, clinic queue, records, medication checklists, and personal tools
login:
Register / verify email, or sign in
with password or linked Google account
dashboard:
Open Pet Owner Home;
load own pets and permitted tools
notes: Booking route depends on the selected service. Routine grooming and Pet Hotel do not require the clinical queue/diagnosis sequence.
Proof submission is not verified payment. An online call becomes joinable when the assigned veterinarian marks it ready.
Only owned/co-owned pets and owner-visible medical content are available. Prescription checklist entries record reported use.

subtitle: Reception, physical examination, grooming, boarding, billing, stock, and controlled record/configuration work
dashboard:
Load assigned clinic context
and enabled Admin feature permissions
notes: Clinical handoff: Admin assignment creates a received vet assignment and places the queue in progress; My List reflects that assignment.
Saved consent and completed intake precede clinical finalization where intake storage is installed. Generic status edits cannot complete clinical work.
Refund handlers exist, but POS has no active Record Refund action. Grooming release follows verified full POS payment; staff still check actual collection.

subtitle: Assigned clinical care, online consultations, record work, prescriptions/certificates, review, and availability
dashboard:
Load assigned clinics, appointments,
and veterinarian workspaces
notes: Current My List is populated by Admin queue assignment. Do not add a compulsory separate Approved List / receive-case screen.
Diagnosis finalization checks the assigned completed intake where installed. Clinical completion creates/reuses billing context; it does not verify payment.
Online availability is a separate recurring call-start calendar. Published branch visits are retired. Only the actual veterinarian role issues medical certificates.
